name: .ZIP File Format Specification
statement: The .ZIP file format, version 6.3.3, which ISO/IEC 21320-1:2015 normatively references: local file headers, the central directory and the end of central directory record. Its notice forbids redistribution, so it is cited only; the text retrieved on 2026-11-27 has SHA-256 bda77700f9cfdd20c2034248e721a02ecb9b003b0c31a00edfe8a10100ce3091.
